title: 筆まる漢字帖 ― 熟語クロス・四字熟語・難読漢字
style: 和紙・墨・朱の落ち着いた和の文房具の世界。生成りの和紙、黒に近い墨色、朱色の差し色、木の文机の温かな茶色。キャラクターは筆の精「筆まる」で、丸くて親しみやすいマスコット調（線がはっきりした、やわらかい塗り）。どの画像にも文字・書・漢字・ロゴを入れない（紙は白紙のまま）。

images.name: key
images.label: キービジュアル：文机と筆・硯
images.use: タイトル画面の背景（半透明で重ね、中央にタイトルとメニューを置くので、中央は白い紙の余白に）
images.ja: 真上から見た木の文机。中央に大きな白紙の和紙、左右に筆・硯・墨・文鎮・朱肉・梅の小枝。フラットで上品なイラスト。紙には何も書かない。
images.prompt: Flat vector illustration, top-down view of a traditional Japanese wooden writing desk: a large blank sheet of cream washi paper in the center, calligraphy brushes on a brush rest, an inkstone with an ink stick, a paperweight, a small vermilion seal-ink case and a sprig of plum blossoms arranged along the left and right edges. Muted cream, warm brown, ink black and vermilion palette, subtle paper texture, elegant and calm, lots of empty space in the center. No text, no letters, no calligraphy characters, the paper is blank. Aspect ratio 16:9.
images.negative: text, letters, kanji, calligraphy characters on the paper, logo, watermark, people
images.generic: A flat vector illustration seen from directly above: a traditional Japanese wooden writing desk with a large blank sheet of cream washi paper in the center; calligraphy brushes on a brush rest, an inkstone with an ink stick, a paperweight, a small vermilion seal-ink case and a sprig of plum blossoms along the left and right edges. Muted cream, warm brown, ink black and vermilion; subtle paper texture; calm, with lots of empty space in the center. No text; the paper is blank. 16:9.
images.notes: Recraft のスタイルは「Vector art」系のフラットなものを選びます。紙に文字が出たら、その部分を消してください。

images.name: bg-washi
images.label: 背景：和紙の質感
images.use: 問題の画面の背景（上に明るい膜を重ねて、文字を読みやすくします）
images.ja: 生成りの手すき和紙の大きな一枚を真上から。こうぞの繊維がうっすら見え、端に向かってわずかに暗くなる。文字や模様はなし。
images.prompt: high resolution top-down photograph of a single large sheet of handmade Japanese washi paper, warm off-white cream color, visible soft kozo fibers and gentle uneven texture, very subtle darker vignette toward the edges, even soft daylight, no objects, no text, no patterns
images.negative: text, letters, stains, folds, objects, shadows of objects, strong patterns
images.generic: A high-resolution top-down photo of one large sheet of handmade Japanese washi paper: warm off-white cream, soft visible kozo fibers and a gentle uneven texture, a very subtle darker vignette toward the edges, even soft daylight. No objects, no text, no patterns.
images.notes: FLUX では 1600×1024 などの 64 の倍数で生成し、ツールが 1600×1000 に切り抜きます。

images.name: mascot-normal
images.label: 筆まる（ふつう）
images.use: タイトル画面のキャラクター（表情の基準）、結果画面
images.ja: オリジナルの筆の精「筆まる」。ずんぐりした太い筆の姿で、白い穂先が頭（墨が少しついて先が黒い）、竹の軸が体。くりっとした目と小さな手足、首に朱色の小さなスカーフ。にっこり笑って片手を上げてあいさつ。全身、正面。
images.prompt: Create an original cute mascot character: a small, chubby spirit of a Japanese calligraphy brush named Fudemaru. Its head is the soft white brush tip with a little black ink on the very end, its body is a short bamboo handle, it has big round friendly eyes, a small smile, tiny arms and legs, and a small vermilion scarf around its neck. It raises one hand in a cheerful greeting. Full body, front view, clean bold outlines and soft flat shading, warm cream, bamboo brown, ink black and vermilion colors. Transparent background PNG, no text. Square 1024x1024.
images.negative: text, letters, kanji, background, realistic human features, scary
images.generic: An original cute mascot: a small chubby spirit of a Japanese calligraphy brush. Its head is the soft white brush tip with a little black ink at the end, its body a short bamboo handle; big round friendly eyes, a small smile, tiny arms and legs, a small vermilion scarf. Raising one hand in a cheerful greeting. Full body, front view, bold clean outlines, soft flat shading. Transparent or plain white background, no text. Square.
images.notes: 3 枚（ふつう・正解・不正解）は同じ ChatGPT の会話で作ります。まずこの画像を作り、ほかの 2 枚はこの画像を添付して「同じキャラクター・同じ画風・同じ大きさのまま、表情とポーズだけを変えて、背景を透明にした PNG で」と頼みます。

images.name: mascot-happy
images.label: 筆まる（正解）
images.use: 正解したときの解説の欄・成績のよい結果
images.ja: 同じ「筆まる」が両手を上げて跳びはね、目を細めて大喜び。穂先がうれしそうに跳ねている。小さな星の飾り。
images.prompt: Using the attached image, keep exactly the same Fudemaru brush-spirit character, same proportions, colors and drawing style, and change only the pose and expression: it jumps with both arms raised, eyes closed in a big happy smile, the brush tip bouncing joyfully, two or three tiny sparkle shapes around it. Full body, front view. Transparent background PNG, no text. Square 1024x1024.
images.generic: The same brush-spirit mascot (white brush-tip head with an inked end, bamboo body, vermilion scarf) jumping with both arms raised, eyes closed in a big happy smile, the brush tip bouncing, two or three tiny sparkles around it. Same style as the reference, full body, transparent or plain white background, no text. Square.
images.notes: mascot-normal の画像を添付して作ります。体の大きさと位置を normal にそろえてください。

images.name: mascot-sad
images.label: 筆まる（不正解）
images.use: 不正解のときの解説の欄・成績が低い結果
images.ja: 同じ「筆まる」が、穂先をしょんぼり垂らして困り顔。片手で頭をかき、汗のしずくを一つ。悲しすぎず、「次はがんばる」雰囲気。
images.prompt: Using the attached image, keep exactly the same Fudemaru brush-spirit character, same proportions, colors and drawing style, and change only the pose and expression: the brush tip droops a little, it scratches its head with one hand with an embarrassed, slightly sad smile and a single small sweat drop, as if saying it will try again. Full body, front view. Transparent background PNG, no text. Square 1024x1024.
images.negative: different character, crying, tears, text, background
images.generic: The same brush-spirit mascot (white brush-tip head with an inked end, bamboo body, vermilion scarf) with its brush tip drooping a little, scratching its head with an embarrassed, slightly sad smile and one small sweat drop, as if it will try again. Same style as the reference, full body, transparent or plain white background, no text. Square.
images.notes: mascot-normal の画像を添付して作ります。
